Fixed in commit ec58565. The root cause was that `packages/core/src/types/index.ts` contains only TypeScript interfaces which don't generate JavaScript at runtime. The solution was to use `export type *` instead of `export *` for the types directory, which tells TypeScript this is a type-only export with no runtime module dependency. Both failing test files now pass.
